title: metadata: a rewrite that keeps the host's stamp turns an environment row into the host's own, and unregistering the host deletes it again (gates the release shipping #32198)
body:
domain:server#4 · os-sales · session_01L6bhgWRcTEB3toGxnWvuvX

Should-fix S1 of the contract review of PR #32999 (card #32986), triage record 6842932691. PR #32999 keeps the environment's own non-slotted rows when the host package is unregistered, by marking the registry object the boot pass stamped; this card covers the writes that replace that object. Not a regression of #32999, and both writes persist the stamp on `main` and in 18.3.0; #32198 (unreleased) is what turns them into deletion. Graded p1 (release line: lands before the release that ships #32198, like #32986); queued for the epic seat.

Filing gate: ② a contract-review routing. class: b · type: Defect · Suggested-grade: p1 · lane: `domain:server`.

## What happens

A write that registers a copy of a stamped environment row keeping `_packageId: <host>` drops PR #32999's mark and persists the stamp into the row's stored body (`DatabaseLoader.save`). From then on the row reads as the host's own, in this process and after a restart, and `unregisterPackage(<host>)` deletes it. Two such writes on `main`, outside #32999's diff:

- ObjectQL's late-manifest bridge (`bridgeManifestObjectsToMetadataService`, `packages/objectql/src/plugin.ts`): when another package extends an environment object ObjectQL owns as the host, the `ownPreviousCopy` arm re-registers the merged object with the host stamp; its withdrawal counterpart `restoreExtendedObjectCopies` does the same.
- `publishPackage` / `revertPackage`: they build `{ ...item.data, … }` over `collectPackageMembers`, which still counts stamped environment rows as host members (rule from #22113), and register the result.

## Do

- Make "an environment row the boot pass stamped" survive a rewrite: either the stamp is never persisted into an environment row's stored body, or membership reads something the rewrite keeps. Pick the route after measuring every writer that registers a copy of a stamped item.
- Pin: after each write above, `unregisterPackage(<host>)` keeps the environment row, in this process and after a reboot from the same database; CONTROL: the host's own rows are still removed; one ablation per pin.
- Also pin, from the same review's nits: a `state: 'draft'` environment row behaves like an `active` one (N1); at least one non-slotted type beyond `object`/`view`/`app`/`hook`/`dashboard`, e.g. `flow` (N2).
- Declare the moved answer (`Clause-②` per AGENTS.md step 3).

Readers who act: `packages/metadata/src/metadata-manager.ts` (`unregisterPackage`, `collectPackageMembers`, `loadMany`), `packages/objectql/src/plugin.ts` (the bridge). Serial: after PR #32999.
